findings.finding: BC provenance train_rows is not reconciled with stored count tables. Two fitted toy records plus train_rows=999 pass validate_bc_payload.
findings.correction: After _validate_provenance require train_rows == sum(league.values()); add synthetic mismatch rejection.

findings.finding: support_table_payload coerces malformed mask to bool before validation: [NaN,1.0] becomes [True,True]. With pitcher9 TRAIN FF only and league FF/SL, it exports intervention SL support for pitcher9.
findings.correction: Require original ndarray shape == vocabulary width and dtype bool before conversion, and validate stored support is a subset of corresponding BC support. Reject malformed masks and unsupported actions.

findings.finding: _CheckedMember assigns ordinal seed without checking returned predictor seed: nominal seed0 with global_model.seed=4 is accepted. Factory hashes requested checkpoint but callback may return wrong loaded model.
findings.correction: Verify returned G0 predictor global_model.seed equals supplied seed and relevant model kind/width/n_classes or enforce a typed validated loader binding. Retain SharingPredictor/training_arrays preprocessing; test swapped returned seeds.

findings.finding: Changed-content retry appends conflict and raises IntegrityError, but does not set halted; summary remains OK and next new request is SUPPORTED. Replay also derives halted only from decision rows, so conflict never halts after restart.
findings.correction: Make integrity conflict set sticky halted state and recover halt from conflict events; keep conflict outside unique-request denominator.

findings.finding: Candidate callback raising TypeError escapes submit without a decision row: synthetic candidate failure leaves requests=0. Unhashable request_id=[] likewise fails membership before validation/ledger record. Current all-request audit excludes these failure paths.
findings.correction: Move trust-boundary request validation/fingerprint inside audited handling; record malformed request metadata safely, then abort. Audit callback exceptions before rethrowing, including TypeError/RuntimeError/model failures, without swallowing KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit.

findings.finding: Runtime retains caller-owned support dictionary/masks and BC object. Mutating original support mask from [True,True] to [True,False] changes reference [0.5,0.5] to [1,0] under identical runtime sha. Frozen identity no longer determines the policy law.
findings.correction: Own validated copies/immutable support and BC state or validate live content against pinned artifact identities before each request; test mutation of original masks and count tables.
